Análise de Operações de :A_DESCRICAO

grid.expression: SELECT DISTINCT TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER TOP, TGFTOP.DESCROPER, ( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER = TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER) qtde, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER = TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER = TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER) * 100 ) / ( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE ((:A_DESCRICAO = 'Compras' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('C','O','E')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Vendas' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('P','D','V')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Transferência' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('T')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Requisição' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('J','Q','L')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Produção' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('F')) ))) END PERCENTUAL FROM TGFTOP WHERE TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND ((:A_DESCRICAO = 'Compras' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('C','O','E')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Vendas' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('P','D','V')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Transferência' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('T')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Requisição' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('J','Q','L')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Produção' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('F'))) GROUP BY TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER, TGFTOP.DESCROPER ORDER BY TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER

Análise de Operações de :A_DESCRICAO por Usuário

grid.expression: SELECT TGFCAB.CODUSU, TSIUSU.NOMEUSU NOMEUSUARIO, TSIGRU.NOMEGRUPO NOMEGRUPO, COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) QTDEOP FROM TGFTOP INNER JOIN TGFCAB ON TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER = TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER AND TGFTOP.DHALTER = TGFCAB.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TSIUSU ON TGFCAB.CODUSU = TSIUSU.CODUSU LEFT JOIN TSIGRU ON TSIGRU.CODGRUPO = TSIUSU.CODGRUPO WHERE TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND ((:A_DESCRICAO = 'Compras' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('C','O','E')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Vendas' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('P','D','V')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Transferência' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('T')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Requisição' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('J','Q','L')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Produção' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('F'))) GROUP BY TGFCAB.CODUSU, TSIUSU.NOMEUSU, TSIGRU.NOMEGRUPO ORDER BY TGFCAB.CODUSU

SELECT DISTINCT TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER TOP, TGFTOP.DESCROPER, ( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND TGFCAB.CODUSU = :A_CODUSU AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER = TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER) qtde, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND TGFCAB.CODUSU = :A_CODUSU AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER = TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND TGFCAB.CODUSU = :A_CODUSU AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER = TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER) * 100 ) / ( SELECT COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) FROM TGFCAB WHERE TGFCAB.CODUSU = :A_CODUSU AND ((:A_DESCRICAO = 'Compras' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('C','O','E')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Vendas' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('P','D','V')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Transferência' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('T')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Requisição' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('J','Q','L')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Produção' AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV IN ('F')) ))) END PERCENTUAL FROM TGFTOP WHERE TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND ((:A_DESCRICAO = 'Compras' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('C','O','E')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Vendas' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('P','D','V')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Transferência' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('T')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Requisição' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('J','Q','L')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Produção' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('F'))) GROUP BY TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER, TGFTOP.DESCROPER ORDER BY TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER

grid.expression: SELECT TGFCAB.CODUSU, TSIUSU.NOMEUSU NOMEUSUARIO, TSIGRU.NOMEGRUPO NOMEGRUPO, COUNT(TGFCAB.NUNOTA) QTDEOP FROM TGFTOP INNER JOIN TGFCAB ON TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER = TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER AND TGFTOP.DHALTER = TGFCAB.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TSIUSU ON TSIUSU.CODUSU = TGFCAB.CODUSU LEFT JOIN TSIGRU ON TSIGRU.CODGRUPO = TSIUSU.CODGRUPO WHERE TGFTOP.CODTIPOPER <> 0 AND TGFCAB.TIPMOV <> 'Z' /* AND TGFCAB.DTALTER >= ADD_MONTHS( SYSDATE, -3 ) AND ((:A_DESCRICAO = 'Compras' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('C','O','E')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Vendas' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('P','D','V')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Transferência' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('T')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Requisição' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('J','Q','L')) OR (:A_DESCRICAO = 'Produção' AND TGFTOP.TIPMOV IN ('F'))) */ GROUP BY TGFCAB.CODUSU, TSIUSU.NOMEUSU, TSIGRU.NOMEGRUPO ORDER BY TGFCAB.CODUSU
